versions.changelog:
Major update — Skill refocused from fitness planning to lunchbox meal planning.

- Rebranded skill name and description from fitness planning ("keep-fit") to lunchbox planning ("lunchbox-planner").
- Updated SKILL.md with comprehensive guidelines for planning practical, nutritious, user-tailored lunch boxes.
- Outlined new core principles: balance nutrition, minimize prep, respect constraints, match the audience, and more.
- Added clear output formatting rules and example requests to guide users and responses.
- Removed obsolete fitness-related script file (scripts/fitness_plan.sh).
